ADX 13.6으로 추세 미형성 상태에서 -DI(31.4)가 +DI(20.5) 상회하며 하락 압력 우위. 5일 저가($942.36)가 20일 저가($897.68)보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 가능성 있으나, 52주 고가($1195.94) 대비 65.5% 위치로 여전히 하락 추세 채널 내. 1배수 목표 비중 채움, 다음 카드는 레버리지 판단 흐름 유지. 재료 균형은 긍정 35 대 부정 65. 핵심 재료는 매파적 Fed 발언 및 유가 상승.
analysis.reasonEn: Three consecutive down candles in the last 5 trading days, especially the -6.90% sharp decline 2 days ago, have strengthened the downtrend. RSI at 42.1 is entering oversold territory. With ADX at 13.6 indicating no trend formation, the -DI (31.4) is above the +DI (20.5), showing a downward pressure advantage. The 5-day low ($942.36) is higher than the 20-day low ($897.68), suggesting a potential Higher Low pattern, but at 65.5% of the 52-week high ($1195.94), it remains within a downtrend channel. The 1x target allocation is filled, with the next card being leverage, maintaining the judgment flow. The material balance is 35 positive vs. 65 negative, with key materials being hawkish Fed remarks and rising oil prices.
